SEOHEAD Tools in non-destructive output mode. The generated PNG is retained outside the public
repository; only the optimized GitHub asset is distributed here.

## Generation prompt

> Redesign this cover to be much cleaner and more premium. Remove every secondary line, every
> number, every feature list, and all text except the exact product name. Use only the verbatim
> text "SEOHEAD Tools". Use minimal Western B2B developer-tool branding: a deep navy background,
> restrained electric-blue accents, subtle technical grid/network geometry, and crisp modern
> sans-serif typography. Use one confident centered title with generous negative space. Keep a
> small terminal prompt mark only if it improves balance. Preserve correct spelling and
> capitalization, strong readability at thumbnail size, and generous safe margins for GitHub
> cropping. No other words or numbers, fake dashboards, screenshots, third-party logos, mascots,
> clutter, or watermark.
